card.statement: The functor $\bigoplus_{\mu}\mathsf{F}_{\mu}$ sends the convolution product $\star$ to the tensor product of $X_{*}(T)$ -graded $\mathbf{k}$ -vector spaces, in a way compatible with the associativity and commutativity constraints.
card.label: Proposition 8.3

paper.title: Notes on the geometric Satake equivalence
paper.abstract: These notes are devoted to a detailed exposition of the proof of the Geometric Satake Equivalence for general coefficients, following Mirkovic-Vilonen.
